# ClusterReadiness

<!-- Generated by tools/gen-docs from internal/crd/manifest.yaml (make docs-gen). Do not edit. -->

The `ClusterReadiness` custom resource, as the agent's embedded CRD manifest defines it. The chart installs the same manifest from `deploy/chart/crds/`.

| | |
|---|---|
| API version | `upgradescope.dev/v1alpha1` |
| Kind | `ClusterReadiness` |
| Scope | Cluster |
| Plural / singular | `clusterreadinesses` / `clusterreadiness` |
| Short names | `ucr` |
| Categories | `upgradescope` |

## v1alpha1

Served: true. Storage version: true.
